title: Supervised classification — OA/Kappa floor against committed truth

assertions.derivation: Lab grid contract: 32x32 Byte class map at 0.001 deg.

Truth is the committed scene map (tests/fixtures/lab/landcover_truth.tif; stands in for D1 ground truth per DECISIONS #8/#13). Pixels where truth is NoData(0) are excluded from the confusion matrix. Floors: OA>=0.85 and kappa>=0.75 — legend-shift or majority-class collapse score far below.

Predicted-side marginals must reproduce the known scene composition over the 992 truth-valid pixels: water 256/992, vegetation 480/992, bare 128/992, urban 128/992. Catches systematic over/under-mapping even when point accuracy is high.
Truth declares 32/1024=3.1% unclassifiable pixels; a correct submission carries them as NoData(0). Ratio 0 = filled pixels the lab required masking.
